recipe.title: Fall Harvest Protein Snack Box
recipe.summary: A no-cook snack box with a Chomps meat stick, green apple, cheese, and pumpkin seeds for 40g of protein on the go.
recipe.story: No cooking, no dishes — just a quick assembly of grab-and-go staples that hits 40g of protein for a school or work snack box.
instructions: Slice the green apple just before packing so it stays fresh and crisp.
Arrange the Chomps meat stick, apple slices, cheese stick, and pumpkin seeds in a snack box or divided container.
Add the almond butter in a small dip container or resealable bag for dipping.
Keep chilled until ready to eat.
tips: Toss the apple slices with a squeeze of lemon juice if packing more than a couple hours ahead to keep them from browning.
Swap the cheese stick for 1/4 cup cottage cheese if you want an even creamier, higher-protein option.
This box travels well in a lunch bag with an ice pack for school or work.
